description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_Strategy_Composite' that manages a collection of strategies for processing HTML tokens. It provides a method to execute all contained strategies sequentially on a set of tokens, utilizing configuration and context objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_Composite
classes.description: An abstract class that aggregates multiple strategies for processing tokens, executing them in order.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs all strategies in the $strategies array sequentially on the provided tokens, config, and context, returning the processed tokens.
